title: Thorne–Zytkow object: period-informed surrogate
model_status: Phenomenological linear-mode illustration. The cited adiabatic periods do not specify nonlinear amplitudes or a unique light curve.

source_papers.title: Farmer et al. (2023), Observational predictions for Thorne–Zytkow objects
source_papers.used_for: Section 4.1 and Fig.5 radial-mode timescales; does not prescribe the amplitudes used here.

source_papers.title: O’Grady et al. (2024/2025), Thorne–Zytkow Objects
source_papers.used_for: Recent review: uncertain formation, stability and candidate identities; photometry is not sufficient identification.

equations.meaning: Linear superposition is an illustrative surrogate using published mode scales, not a reconstruction of nonlinear stellar evolution.

assumed_parameters_origin: Illustrative scenario choices, not measurements, posterior estimates, or universal class properties; exceptions identified in paper_constraints.

paper_constraints.origin: Farmer et al. 2023 §4.1 and Fig.5; chosen illustrative periods are not one tabulated stellar solution.
paper_constraints.amplitudes_and_phases: Chosen for display; not predicted by the papers.

limitations: One illustrative geometry and parameter choice, not the population distribution or a prediction of discovery rate.
Gaussian noise is illustrative; stellar variability, blending variability, quality flags, gaps and extraction systematics are absent.
No identity, mass or primordial origin can be established from morphological similarity alone.
No nonlinear hydrodynamics, convection, mode excitation/damping, dust, atmosphere or Kepler-band radiative transfer.
Amplitudes and waveform are unconstrained here; never treat this shape as a TZO fingerprint.
A 1470-day Kepler baseline cannot resolve a full 2000-day fundamental cycle.
Spectroscopy and stellar-evolution modeling are needed to distinguish candidate TZO interpretations from normal supergiants and AGB stars.

noise_free_curve.note: Display table thinned to roughly 12000 points; exposure integration used the full internal grid.

numerics.time_integration: Boxcar from cumulative trapezoidal integral; <= exposure/32 internal timestep
numerics.source_surface_brightness: Uniform disk for lensing; no limb darkening
numerics.noise: Independent Gaussian, fixed seed; not a realistic KBonus noise model
numerics.photometric_band: Achromatic geometric-lensing approximation; TZO is an uncalibrated relative-flux proxy

classification_limit: For proposing follow-up hypotheses only; neither a detection model nor validation. Similar ordinary objects and instrumental effects must be tested independently.
